pages.text: Deprive one sense and the others grow sharper... the classic theory of training.$(br2)Same as always: right-click the target to equip or remove.
$(item)Gag Mask$() — speech completely muted; only muffled squeaks come out♡ From another's view, it even looks kind of... cute? Wear it too long and you'll be drooling, meow~
$(item)Eye Patch$() — with sight taken away, every single touch brings double the surprise.
$(item)Earplug$() — can't hear the commands, so intuition is all that's left. Hey hey, whatever improper use you're imagining right now...
